Underworld Editor (Avalonia) VERSION
A level editor for Ultima Underworld I and II.

Run UwEditorAvalonia (UwEditorAvalonia.exe on Windows), then File > Open game folder
and pick the game folder (the one with DATA in it), the DATA folder or a SAVEn folder.
The manual is in the program: Help > Manual.

This is a beta: back up your game folder (or use Tools > Mods) before saving edits.

Linux: chmod +x UwEditorAvalonia if the bit was lost. Needs OpenGL 3.3.
macOS: the build is not notarised. In Terminal, in this folder:
    xattr -d com.apple.quarantine UwEditorAvalonia
    ./UwEditorAvalonia
Windows: SmartScreen may warn about an unknown publisher: More info > Run anyway.

Source and issues: https://github.com/KarlClinckspoor/UltimaUnderworldEditorAvalonia
